question: When may a cache use heuristic freshness?

claims.text: A cache may assign a heuristic expiration time when an explicit expiration time is not specified in the response.
A cache must not use heuristics to determine freshness when an explicit expiration time is present in the stored response.
A cache can use heuristics only on responses without explicit freshness whose status codes are defined as heuristically cacheable or that have been marked as explicitly cacheable.
When s-maxage, max-age, and Expires do not provide an explicit expiration time, a heuristic freshness lifetime might be applicable.
